# Joint macrostate probability distribution ln Pi(N_CO2, N_C3H8) of CO2/propane in all-silica mordenite (MOR, 2x2x4
# unit cells) at 300 K, from N-d TMMC (18 overlapping tiles of the walk_tiles arm, bias refined every 1e3 cycles, 1e5
# Monte Carlo steps per state in production, one seed, 239 CPU-h), pooled and solved by C-weighted least squares
# (edge weights floored at 1e-12 of the largest) in tmmc/mor_co2_propane/analysis.ipynb. Model of Sharma et al., Mol.
# Phys. 2023: TraPPE-zeo framework with charges, CO2 of Garcia-Sanchez et al. 2009, united-atom propane, LJ cut and
# shifted at 12 A, Ewald. Written 2026-11-19 (LOG entry 80).
#
# Reference: fugacities f_CO2 = f_C3H8 = 1.0e5 Pa (fugacity coefficients 1, so an equimolar gas at 2e5 Pa);
# ln Pi is normalized to unit total probability over the states listed here.
# Reweight exactly to any fugacities:  ln Pi(N; f) = ln Pi(N) + N_CO2 ln(f_CO2 / 1e5) + N_C3H8 ln(f_C3H8 / 1e5),
# then normalize; <N_i> = sum_N N_i Pi(N; f). Loading: 46.1447 molecules per box = 1 mol/kg.
# Temperature (Chen & Lin 2023, eq 7 of the paper): ln Pi(N; T') = ln Pi(N) + N_tot ln(T/T') - dbeta <U> +
# dbeta^2 var(U)/2, dbeta = 1/T' - 1/T [1/K], with the ideal-gas intramolecular energy of propane (3/2 T per
# molecule, variance 3/2 T^2) subtracted from <U> and var(U); at fixed fugacities.
#
# Domain: 9865 of the 15251 states of their grid N_CO2 + N_C3H8 <= 200, N_C3H8 <= 100 (the walks did
# not reach the rest). A reweighted condition is trustworthy only while the total probability of the states with
# frontier = 1 (the edge of this domain) stays below about 1e-3; beyond, the distribution is truncated and loadings
# come out too low. With that rule this distribution covers every gas composition up to a total fugacity of about
# 1e6 Pa, and 94 % of the compositions up to 1e7 Pa.
#
# lnpi_error: standard deviation of ln Pi over 20 bootstrap replicas of the collection matrix (noise level from
# the loop closures, g = 0.45); statistical only. Against binary and pure GCMC from 10 Pa to 1e6 Pa the
# reweighted loadings deviate by 2.3 % on average, by 7-20 % at one to two molecules per box (below ~300 Pa).
# Energies [K]: average and variance of the potential energy, average intramolecular energy, from the 'visits'
# production samples of the state (0 visits: energies NaN).
#
